title: Rethinking Time Series Tokenization from a Frequency Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2610.28997v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tokenization that partitions time series into subsequences has become a foundational paradigm in modern time series modeling. However, we find that current tokenization strategies inherently introduce spectral distortions, forcing the learned representations to diverge from the true underlying patterns such as trend, periodicity, and seasonality, thereby impairing model performance. Through theoretical analysis from a frequency perspective, we derive the boundary conditions under which such distortions occur. To overcome this distortion, we propose TimeFT, a nearly distortion-free frequency-based tokenizer for time series data. TimeFT obtains tokens through frequency-domain partitioning, frequency shifting, and Nyquist sampling. The method is parameter-free, incurs negligible computational complexity, and can serve as a drop-in replacement for existing tokenizers. translated_title: 从频率视角重新思考时间序列分词
translated_abstract: 将时间序列划分为子序列的分词方法已成为现代时间序列建模的基础范式。然而，我们发现当前的分词策略固有地引入了频谱失真，迫使学习到的表示偏离真实的底层模式（如趋势、周期性和季节性），从而损害模型性能。通过从频率视角进行理论分析，我们推导出了这种失真发生的边界条件。为了克服这种失真，我们提出了TimeFT，一种几乎无失真的基于频率的时间序列数据分词器。TimeFT通过频域划分、频率移位和奈奎斯特采样来获取token。该方法无需参数，计算复杂度可忽略不计，并可作为现有分词器的即插即用替代品。我们在预测、分类等多种任务上的大量实验……
tldr: 提出了一种几乎无失真的基于频率的时间序列分词器TimeFT，通过频域划分、频率移位和奈奎斯特采样获取token，无需参数且可作为现有分词器的即插即用替代品，有效避免传统分词带来的频谱失真问题。
en_tdlr: TimeFT is a nearly distortion-free, frequency-based time series tokenizer that obtains tokens through frequency-domain partitioning, frequency shifting, and Nyquist sampling, requiring no parameters and serving as a drop-in replacement for existing tokenizers to eliminate spectral distortions.
